sand.label: Sand
sand.description: Sand-rich mineral soil. Its coarse texture influences water retention and cultivation.

loam.label: Loam
loam.description: Mixed mineral soil containing sand, silt and clay.

silt.label: Silt
silt.description: Silt-rich mineral soil. Fine particles influence water storage and soil stability.

clay.label: Clay
clay.description: Clay-rich mineral soil. Heavy texture influences cultivation and water management.

peat.label: Peat
peat.description: Organic soil formed through the accumulation of plant remains. Organic content alone does not establish fertility.

stony.label: Stony
stony.description: Substantial gravel, stones or concretions reduce the volume of fine soil available for cultivation.
